entries.zh: 悔；懊悔、悔恨（悔改；转悔）
entries.en: to repent, to feel remorse

entries.zh: 悔悟；为自己的言行而悔恨（对己所言之事懊悔）
entries.en: to repent and realize one's error; to regret what one said about oneself

entries.zh: 悔过；为过错悔改
entries.en: to repent of one's faults

entries.zh: 悛；悔改罪过、改过自新
entries.en: to repent of one's sins, to reform

entries.zh: 悛解；悔改解开罪愆
entries.en: to repent and be released (from guilt)
entries.notes: R 栏 guài 与 M 栏 cǎj 对应汉字（解）在 R 对音上有出入，展开依赖推断

entries.zh: 改；改正、悔改
entries.en: to change, to amend

entries.zh: 改过；改正过错
entries.en: to correct one's faults, to repent of one's sins

entries.zh: 苦切；痛苦地悔恨、切齿懊悔
entries.en: to repent bitterly, in anguish

entries.zh: 反悔；事后懊悔（汉字栏作「及悔」，音写 huǎn 应即「反」，存疑）
entries.en: to change one's mind, to regret afterwards
entries.notes: 汉字「及悔」与音写 huǎn-hûe（反悔）不合，疑为字栏辨识误差

entries.zh: 羞悔；羞愧而悔恨
entries.en: to repent with shame, to be ashamed and repent

entries.zh: 翻悔前言；为先前说过的话反悔、改口（汉字栏「話咀兩反」有辨识疑点）
entries.en: to retract what one said before, to go back on one's word
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:話/詁]，且语序与音写对应不完全吻合

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕上；向上（汉字栏空缺，西语栏混入「Abar el navio…」别条文字）
entries.en: up, above (entry damaged; Spanish column carries over text of another entry)
entries.notes: 汉字栏 [空]、R 栏 [残]，仅余 M 栏 chiō̃ 一个音

entries.zh: 倚；倚靠、靠近
entries.en: to lean on, to depend on
entries.notes: 西语栏 [空]，释义据汉字「倚」与音写补足

entries.zh: 倚壁；靠着墙壁
entries.en: to lean against the wall

entries.zh: 倚赖；依靠、依赖
entries.en: to rely on, to depend upon
entries.notes: 西语栏 fabro de R.o. 疑含缩写残损，但四栏主体（倚赖/ǒa lōa）互证清晰

entries.zh: 附；依附、亲近（依附于善友）
entries.en: to attach oneself to, to join (good friendship)

entries.zh: 附会；依附结交、与人亲近成友
entries.en: to associate with, to make friends with

entries.zh: 依；依靠、依从
entries.en: to depend on, to comply with

entries.zh: 狭（侠）；与人相偎亲近、挤在一处（汉字栏作「俠」，音写 hiap 亦可对应「狹」，存疑）
entries.en: to crowd close to another, to huddle together
entries.notes: 汉字「俠」与义项 arrimarse con otro 不合，疑应为「狹/偕」类字

entries.zh: 泊；停泊（船只停靠；另音 chī，泊于某处）
entries.en: to moor, to anchor (of a ship)
entries.notes: M 栏双音 pǒ; chȳ 对应「泊」两读

entries.zh: 叠；把房屋一座座挨着排建、叠置相接
entries.en: to pile up, to place (houses) adjoining one another

entries.zh: 叠做葩；叠成一丛、房屋层层相叠
entries.en: to pile up in clusters, layered one upon another
entries.notes: 「葩」字义与西语 arrimar vnas casas otras 对应略曲折，展开依赖推断

entries.zh: 叠做夥；叠聚成群、并作一处
entries.en: to join together in a group, to gather in one place

entries.zh: 连；相连、连成一行（西语 xingflera 疑为 fila「排/行」之讹写）
entries.en: to link up, to arrange in a row
entries.notes: 西语 xingflera 为讹写或缩写，展开依赖推断；汉字「连」与音写互证清晰

entries.zh: 重重；重重叠叠、层层相叠相伴（汉字栏标注疑为「重疊」）
entries.en: layer upon layer, in overlapping succession
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:重重/重疊]，且西语 ocblano 为明显讹字（或 otro 辅音之讹）
